review.imagery: 62 gallery entries include 14 dated site photographs. All twenty-five primary assets, the complete official 73-page brochure index, 162 native resources and fourteen September 2026 photographs were visually reviewed. Two repeated primary compositions and three lower-resolution interior counterparts were excluded. Twenty-seven native brochure scenes add gym, clubhouse, sauna, reception and separate home concepts. Repeated raster fragments, atlas strips, backgrounds and generic lifestyle photographs were excluded. One complete unedited brochure architecture page adds a whole-tower context view, preserving its printed wording. The official podium/tower scene supplies card and hero.
review.floorPlans: All seven whole physical plan pages 1–7 were visually reviewed on two contacts. Ground retail, first-floor architectural/amenity views, floors 2–18, the level 19 gym/club room, floors 20–32 and roof retain their source labels. No unit saleable area was inferred from room dimensions or a whole-floor drawing. The inspected Silver Oak page has no open floor-plan section. Original margins, legends and source links remain intact. Seven complete building sheets distinguish arrival/retail, both first-floor drawing views, the level 19 amenities and grouped homes. No individual saleable areas are printed. Confirm standalone contractual home sheets, exact units, areas and final revisions with Imtiaz.
review.location: Whole original official brochure map 69 and numerical schedule 70 were rendered at 3200 pixels and visually read. All twenty-five selected destination estimates follow the printed schedule individually. Map rings were not converted to route values. The official named-place embed supplies no explicit target coordinate pair and camera-centre values were excluded.
review.provenance: Official project/gallery and September 2026 construction sources retain dated URL and SHA-256 receipts. Original brochures and building drawings retain their actual developer, broker or platform-host attribution. Whole sheets, notices and original source bytes remain intact. Protected researched records remain preserved.

unavailable: Standalone contractual home drawings and saleable areas, exact visitor entrance, current certified site progress, release-specific differences from shared Cove interiors, final specifications and guaranteed views remain unavailable or unverified.
